title: The Magic That Started Everything
overview: Coco, a girl fascinated by magic, meets Qifrey and discovers the secrets of witches.

title: The School of the Grassland
overview: Coco meets her fellow students and starts to learn the fundamentals of magic.

title: The Dadah Range Test
overview: While Qifrey is away, Agott pushes Coco into taking a dangerous test.

title: Meeting In Kalhn
overview: Qifrey takes Coco to the witches' town of Kalhn, where she has an unexpected encounter.

title: The Dragon's Labyrinth
overview: The four apprentice witches strive to find a solution to their calamitous situation.

title: A Light on a Rainy Day
overview: On a rainy day, the apprentices enjoy a picnic outside and meet their Watchful Eye.

title: Who Is Magic For?
overview: The apprentices are allowed to come along on a dangerous rescue mission.

title: The Misgivings of the Knights Moralis
overview: When the Knights Moralis arrive, Coco and Agott must deal with the aftermath of their actions.

title: A Nightmare Stained In Black
overview: Qifrey investigates a new clue to the Brimmed Caps while Coco continues to struggle with guilt.

title: A Promise in Silver
overview: Coco lies ill in the hospital, while Tartah gains new self-confidence through magic.

title: The Test in Serpentback Cave
overview: Richeh reveals her distaste for spells that are not her own, while Agott gets the date for her second test.

title: The Shadow of Romonon
overview: Qifrey tells Coco the history of the Romonon cave, while Agott and the examinees face its topsy-turvy magic.

title: Forbidden Magic
overview: Trapped in the Serpentback Cave, Agott, Richeh, and Euini face a terrifying threat from a Brimmed Cap witch.
